entries.en: You hear about Santiago? Used to be a nomad, long time ago...
entries.ro: Ai auzit de Santiago? Era nomad, demult...

entries.en: Ever heard of our lord and savior Jesus Christ?
entries.ro: Ai auzit vreodată de Domnul și Mântuitorul nostru, Iisus Hristos?

entries.en: Friend o' mine did a job with him once.
entries.ro: Un amic de-al meu a lucrat cu el odată.
De ce îl pomenește lumea deodată pe Santiago?

entries.en: That's one old friend you got.
entries.ro: Asta-i un prieten vechi de-al tău.

entries.en: He's a legend, all right. Wouldn't say he was my role model, but well... he was the man for his time and place.
entries.ro: E o legendă, ce să zic. N-aș spune că e modelul meu, dar... a fost omul potrivit pentru vremurile lui.

entries.en: Sounds like he's not so legendary for you.
entries.ro: Parcă nu-i chiar așa legendar pentru tine.

entries.en: You don't think he was all he was cracked up to be?
entries.ro: Nu crezi că era cât se zice?

entries.en: Want to talk about something else.
Something else I want to talk about.
They say he was a big city nomad. Best o' both worlds.
entries.ro: Se zice că a fost nomad de oraș. Cel mai bun din ambele lumi.

entries.en: Cept there ain't no such thing. You're either loyal to your family, or you ain't.
entries.ro: Doar că nu-i chestie de-asta. Ori ești loial familiei tale, ori nu.

entries.en: Doesn't loyalty to your friends count for something?
entries.ro: Nu contează deloc loialitatea față de prieteni?

entries.en: Maybe it does. Then you end up like Santiago.
He snuffed it 'cause some lunatic wanted to blow Arasaka to smithereens.
entries.ro: A dat colțul fiindcă un nebun voia să arunce Arasaka în aer.
